project_type: React Native mobile app (Expo SDK 54, expo-router) — the native rebuild of the 4A Store WebView app. Part of the 4astore-v2 monorepo (web + api-node + mobile).
build_system: Expo (expo prebuild + gradlew for APK/AAB). For THIS visual task no native build is needed — verification is TypeScript typecheck only. tsconfig.json extends 'expo/tsconfig.base' which lives in node_modules, so typecheck REQUIRES node_modules to be present.
test_framework: None. No unit test runner is configured in mobile/package.json. Verification is `tsc --noEmit` (script: npm run typecheck) plus manual code-trace. This is a React Native app so there is NO browser and no DOM to render-test.
build_command: npm install   (ONE TIME, in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\app-ui-polish\4astore-v2\mobile — the worktree currently has NO node_modules; uses committed package-lock.json, adds no new deps)
test_command: npx tsc --noEmit   (equivalently: npm run typecheck) — run from c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\app-ui-polish\4astore-v2\mobile. Expected: exit 0, no errors.
verification_instructions: 1) If node_modules is absent in the worktree mobile dir, run `npm install` once (do NOT add deps). 2) Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\app-ui-polish\4astore-v2\mobile and confirm exit code 0. 3) Code-trace the changed screens to confirm no data/logic/handler lines changed — only styles, StyleSheet entries, token references, and layout props (flexDirection/alignItems/gap/minHeight/borderRadius/fontSize). 4) `git -C c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\app-ui-polish diff --stat` should show changes concentrated in src/theme.ts, src/components/ui.tsx, src/components/Icon.tsx, app/product/[id].tsx with only tiny style diffs on other screens and minimal/zero diff in parallel-owned files. WARNING: without node_modules, tsc emits hundreds of phantom errors (Cannot find module 'fs', global 'Promise', etc.) — that is the missing-deps symptom, not a code error.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. `npx tsc` with no local install tries to download the WRONG 'tsc@2.0.4' package and hangs on an interactive prompt — install deps first so the local typescript@5.9.3 binary is used. NO new npm dependency may be added (no @expo/vector-icons or any native icon lib). Do NOT touch tracking/rider BEHAVIOR (TrackMap.tsx data flow, app/rider.tsx GPS/accept/setStatus, /tracking routes) — pure visual styling there is OK, how they work must not change. Do NOT change any data fetching, React Query hooks, API calls, caching, or auth/session.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING in the mobile dir; README.md documents build/signing only. Design tokens in src/theme.ts are the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — reuse them, never hardcode new hex/sizes in screens. Keep all bilingual Hindi/English copy verbatim. A parallel workflow on branch app-local-first owns these files: app/checkout.tsx, app/(tabs)/orders.tsx, app/page/[slug].tsx, app/admin/orders.tsx, src/store/addresses.ts (new, not present yet), and possibly src/api.ts / src/store/auth.ts — MINIMIZE edits to them, keep any edit to a single style prop, mark it with a `// ui-polish: style-only` comment, and prefer not touching them at all.
key_patterns: Primary buttons = GradientButton (minHeight 48, pill radius, warmGradient). Secondary = Button (minHeight 44 radius.sm; small variant minHeight 34). Icons = emoji via Icon.tsx with a size scale (xs/sm/md/lg/xl) — every call site already passes a size key, so changing the SIZE map propagates app-wide with no call-site edits. Shared text roles live in ui.tsx `styles` (h2/h3/sectionTitle/muted/label/btnText/totalText). Gradient surfaces use warmGradient / AnimatedGradient; status chips use STATUS_STYLE via StatusChip. radius tokens { sm:8, md:12, lg:18, pill:30 }. Screen wrapper pads 14. Theme colors: primary #ff7a00, primaryDark #c62828, accent #E53935, dark #291b16, gray #76645c, lightGray #fffaf3, border #f1d8ba, green #087a3d, whatsapp #25D366, track #0891b2, admin #2C6FAD, glass rgba(255,255,255,0.92).
